status: Experimental entry-level CJS/default facade Source, no native/guest execution or installed factory amendment.
moduleContract: Pinned full Node22 export inventory and provider constants retained; native ALS-backed bounded AsyncResource constructor + runInAsyncScope on mutable CJS/default only. Old frozen ESM named binding remains deferred.

supportedStatic: AsyncResource (string type, options undefined; CJS/default entry binding only)
node:async_hooks.callablePolicy: Native mutable resource cells and real SM147 registration/creation/job hooks; per-instance synchronous restoration preserves other instance changes and original throws. Disabled stores are excluded at child capture without expiring old cells. Deferred API calls/construction throw coded ERR_SM_NODE_UNSUPPORTED;63 frozen provider numbers are metadata only, not implemented providers. Entry AsyncResource captures actual AsyncLocalStorage.snapshot at construction and invokes it around Reflect.apply; no JS context stack or new native service.
node:async_hooks.unsupportedPrototypePolicy: AsyncResource.bind/emitDestroy/asyncId/triggerAsyncId remain coded ERR_SM_NODE_UNSUPPORTED; no IDs, hooks or destroy delivery are implemented.
deviations: Only the existing content/initializer shared compartment is eligible; unknown jobs/layouts/foreign compartments refuse. Private PromiseReactionRecord discrimination pins SM9dab/147 class and11slots.
Legacy queue selected before application registration. SM off-thread/delayed dispatch is refused one-way and reported at checkpoint, not silently dropped.
SM AllocationMetadataBuilder callback/table failure is fatal component allocation failure; no recoverable-OOM claim or OOM/GC-pressure probe.
Per-resource/job/argument caps differ from Node; overflow is ERR_SM_NODE_ASYNC_CONTEXT_LIMIT.
Bound asyncResource deprecation accessors/names/warning delivery and broad AsyncResource compatibility are not claimed.

Fresh request owner is native/private HTTP-kernel entry; ordinary app imports receive no extra async_hooks name. Descendants inherit owner after initial JS return; cancellation/expired host handle teardown remains separately required.
No new external host capability, engine/guest execution, security/adoption or reusable/reset-safe snapshot claim.
Neutral server readiness uses a distinct persistent native server resource; fresh request roots never inherit its store bindings. Body/stream creation must occur inside the future HTTP fresh entry.

Before pre-snapshot/reset boundaries, the native queue must be empty/inactive/successful and current owner must be the neutral server; rejected off-thread dispatch stays a failure. This is not a reset-safety claim.
FinalizationRegistry registration-context propagation is outside this ALS contract; existing finalizer ordering/strict exception policy is preserved without a new ALS finalizer hook.

Custom Promise species returning a non-Promise are refused explicitly: no cross-request owner is inferred from the resolver context. Ordinary actual-Promise species/await/reactions remain in the proposed contract.
Entry facade replaces only mutable CJS/default.AsyncResource; frozen named ESM references and earlier cached constructors remain old.
Constructor options are deferred; non-string type rejects; type length above4096 and more than1023 user arguments refuse.
Invalid callback throws coded ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE; pinned Node22 uses uncoded TypeError here.
Installation is pure INIT. Application constructors are ordinary deployed by existing bootstrap/order policy, not by a new JS phase assertion; no INIT capture/snapshot-reuse proof.
